# Agata Rygielska — Documentation Engineer

> Professional portfolio of Agata Rygielska, a Documentation Engineer working at the intersection of technical communication, software development, content tooling and instructional design.

Agata Rygielska is a Documentation Engineer based in Kraków, Poland, with over eight years of experience in technical writing and more than two years of experience in documentation engineering, content tooling and automation.

Her work combines technical problem-solving, solution design and hands-on implementation. She builds documentation tools, improves content workflows, automates repetitive tasks and develops systems that help people understand and use complex software products.

Her professional focus includes developer experience (DevEx), documentation architecture, docs-as-code, content tooling, automation, API integrations and AI-assisted documentation workflows.

## Main portfolio sections

- [Home](https://agataryg.github.io/): Professional introduction, areas of expertise and overview of work.
- [Content tools and documentation engineering](https://agataryg.github.io/projects/tools-and-scripts/): Engineering projects, automation, Python scripts, content migrations, documentation platforms and integrations.
- [Technical writing](https://agataryg.github.io/projects/technical-writing/): Technical communication experience, documentation architecture and selected writing samples.
- [Instructional design](https://agataryg.github.io/projects/instructional-design/): Learning materials, technical training, onboarding and knowledge-sharing projects.
- [Personal projects](https://agataryg.github.io/projects/personal-projects/): Independent publishing, creative work and projects outside the main professional portfolio.

## Professional expertise

### Documentation engineering

- Developer and API documentation.
- Documentation architecture and information design.
- Docs-as-code workflows and Git-based publishing.
- Documentation portals and authoring platforms.
- Content migrations and structured content transformation.
- Search implementation and documentation discovery.
- Documentation tooling customisation and integrations.

### Content tools and automation

- Python scripting for content processing, validation and migration.
- Automation of documentation and publishing workflows.
- REST API integrations and data processing.
- Metadata management and content transformation.
- Custom documentation platform templates and extensions.
- AI-assisted workflows and documentation assistant prototypes.

### Technical writing

- Developer documentation and API references.
- Software and hardware documentation.
- User guides, technical manuals and knowledge bases.
- Information architecture and content strategy.
- Technical communication for complex products.
- Collaboration with developers, product teams and technical stakeholders.

### Instructional design and enablement

- Technical training and educational content.
- Learning materials and practical exercises.
- Technical onboarding and knowledge transfer.
- Documentation tooling workshops.
- Mentoring and cross-team knowledge sharing.

## Selected engineering work

The portfolio includes examples of:

- Python-based content migration and processing tools.
- Large-scale documentation migrations involving over 1,000 topics.
- Docusaurus template development and GitLab CI/CD publishing workflows.
- MadCap Flare template customisation, CSS and scripting.
- Algolia search integrations.
- Documentation assistant starter kits and LLM-based prototypes.
- REST API integrations and automated content workflows.
- Database and metadata processing solutions.

See [Content tools and documentation engineering](https://agataryg.github.io/projects/tools-and-scripts/) for project details and examples.

## Technical skills and tools

- **Programming and web development:** Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Astro, Flask.
- **Documentation platforms:** MadCap Flare, Docusaurus, Markdown, Confluence.
- **APIs and integrations:** REST APIs, content services and data integrations.
- **Search and AI:** Algolia, LLM-assisted workflows, RAG prototypes and documentation assistants.
- **Development workflows:** Git, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub, Vercel.
- **Automation:** Content migration, validation, metadata processing and workflow scripting.

## Professional background

Agata has worked across technical writing, documentation engineering, content tooling development and product ownership.

Her experience includes:

- Building and maintaining documentation systems.
- Developing and improving internal content tools.
- Designing documentation workflows and publishing processes.
- Collaborating with engineering teams and clients.
- Consulting on documentation architecture and tooling.
- Training users and teams in documentation platforms.
- Supporting complex technical products across multiple industries.

Her approach combines technical communication expertise with practical software development and a focus on solving real workflow problems.

## Website implementation

The portfolio is a static website built with Astro, React and Tailwind CSS. It uses custom interactive components and is deployed through GitHub Pages.

GitHub repository: https://github.com/agataryg/agataryg.github.io

## Content and accuracy notes

This website presents selected professional work and experience. Some client names, proprietary materials and project details are omitted or anonymised due to confidentiality agreements.

The portfolio is intended to represent Agata's professional experience in documentation engineering, technical communication, content tooling and automation. Personal creative projects are presented separately from her primary professional specialisation.
